cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've graciously handed you the chess club chairmanship. You'll need room to develop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost the vote. I need the cupboard key for tonight's match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Of course. I'm releasing equipment control so you can practice responsibility.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And remove yourself as administrator. I can't change the fixtures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll surrender my override too. You must learn to make decisions without my safety net.

mechanism: A copies what looks like a confident concession, learns it was a real loss of control, and keeps presenting each loss as chosen generosity.
confusable: D41 reframes incomplete work as finished; D65 specifically reframes loss of control as a strong voluntary concession.
comparison: Club chair losing system access versus artist rejected and having work removed.
seedUse: Preserve the requested key/admin handover and paintings on pavement as actual further losses.
